verses.geez:
ወይቤላ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ለእንታክቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ አሕየወ፡ ላቲ፡ ወልዳ፡ ተንሥኢ፡ ወሖሪ፡ አንቲኒ፡ ወቤትኪ፡ ወንበሪ፡
            ኀበ፡ ነበርኪ፡ ትካት፡ እስመ፡ ረኃበ፡ ይፌኑ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወእምዝ፡ መጽአ፡ ረኃብ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡
            ፯ዓመተ።
verses.translation: And Elisaie spoke to the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thy house, and sojourn wherever thou mayest sojourn: for the Lord has called for a famine upon the land; indeed it is come upon the land for seven years.

verses.geez: ወተንሥአት፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወገብረት፡ በከመ፡ ይቤላ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ወሖረት፡ ብሔረ፡ ኢሎፍሊ፡ ወነበረት፡ ፯ዓመተ።
verses.translation: And the woman arose, and did according to the word of Elisaie, both she and her house; and they sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ፯ዓመት፡ አተወት፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወገብአት፡ እምብሔረ፡ ኢሎፍሊ፡ ወሖረት፡ ወዐውየወት፡ ኀበ፡
            ንጉሥ፡ በእንተ፡ ቤታ፡ ወበእንተ፡ አዕጻዳቲሃ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the expiration of the seven years, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines to the city; and came to cry to the king for her house and for her lands.

verses.geez: ወተስእሎ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ለግያዝ፡ ወልዱ፡ ለኤልሳዕ፡ ለብእሴ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ንግረኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ ነኪር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኤልሳዕ።
verses.translation: And the king spoke to Giezi the servant of Elisaie the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things which Elisaie has done.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ እንዘ፡ ይነግሮ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ዘከመ፡ አሕየወ፡ ሕፃነ፡ ዘሞተ፡ ወመጽአት፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ አሕየወ፡ ላቲ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ሕፃና፡ ዐውየወት፡ ኀበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ በእንተ፡ ቤታ፡ ወበእንተ፡ አዕጻዳቲሃ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ግያዝ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ንጉሥ፡
            ነያ፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወነዋ፡ ሕፃናሂ፡ ዘአሕየወ፡ ኤልሳዕ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored to life the dead son, behold, the woman whose son Elisaie restored to life came crying to the king for her house and for her lands. And Giezi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisaie restored to life.

verses.geez:
ወተስእለ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወነገረቶ፡ ወወሀባ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ፩እምውስተ፡ ኅጽዋኑ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ አግብእ፡ ላቲ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋያ፡ ወኵሎ፡
            እክለ፡ አዕጻዳቲሃ፡ ዘእምአመ፡ ኀደገት፡ ብሔራ፡ ወእስከ፡ ዘይእዜ።
verses.translation: And the king asked the woman, and she told him: and the king appointed her a eunuch, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field from the day that she left the land until now.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ብሔረ፡ ደማስቆ፡ ወደወየ፡ ወልደ፡ አዴር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ወነገርዎ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ መጽአ፡ ብእሴ፡
            እግዚአብሔር፡ ዝየ።
verses.translation: And Elisaie came to Damascus; and the king of Syria the son of Ader was ill, and they brought him word, saying, The man of God is come hither.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ለአዛሔል፡ ንሣእ፡ መና፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወሖር፡ ተቀበሎ፡ ለብእሴ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወተሰአሎ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እመ፡ አሐዩ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ደዌየ።
verses.translation: And the king said to Azael, Take in thine hand a present, and go to meet the man of God, and enquire of the Lord by him, saying, Shall I recover of this my disease?

verses.geez:
ወሖረ፡ አዛሔል፡ ወተቀበሎ፡ ወነሥአ፡ መና፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወእምውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሠናይ፡ ዘብሔረ፡ ደማስቆ፡ ወ፵ገምል፡ ይጸውሩ፡
            አርሶን፡ ወሖረ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ለኤልሳዕ፡ ወልድከ፡ ወልደ፡ አዴር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ፈነወኒ፡ ኀቤከ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ አሐዩኑአ፡ እምነአ፡ ዝአ፡ ደዌየአ።
verses.translation: And Azael went to meet him, and he took a present in his hand, and all the good things of Damascus, forty camels' load, and came and stood before him, and said to Elisaie, Thy son the son of Ader, the king of Syria, has sent me to thee to enquire, saying, Shall I recover of this my disease?

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ሖር፡ በሎ፡ ሐዪወሰአ፡ ኢተሐዩአ፡ አንተአ፡ ወአርአየኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ሞተ፡ ትመውት።
verses.translation: And Elisaie said, Go, say, Thou shalt certainly live; yet the Lord has shewed me that thou shalt surely die.

verses.geez: ወበጽሐ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ወኀፈረ፡ ብእሴ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወበከየ።
verses.translation: And he stood before him, and fixed his countenance till he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ፡ አዛሔል፡ ምንተ፡ ያበኪዮ፡ ለእግዚእየ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ኣአምር፡ መጠነ፡ ሀለወከ፡ ትረስዮሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡
            እስራኤል ፤ አህጉሪሆሙ፡ ታውዒ፡ በእሳት፡ ወትቀትል፡ ኄሮሙ፡ በኲናት፡ ወትነፅር፡ ሕፃናቲሆሙ፡ ወታነ[ቅ]ዖን፡ ለፅኑሳቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: And Azael said, Why does my lord weep? And he said, Because I know all the evil that thou wilt do to the children of Israel: thou wilt utterly destroy their strong holds with fire, and thou wilt slay their choice men with the sword, and thou wilt dash their infants against the ground, and their women with child thou wilt rip up.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ፡ አዛሔል፡ ምንትኑ፡ አነ፡ ገብርከ፡ ዘከመ፡ ከልብ፡ ምውት፡ ከመ፡ እግበሮ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ነገር፡ ወይቤሎ፡
            ኤልሳዕ፡ አርአየኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኪያከ፡ እንዘ፡ ትነግሥ፡ ለሶርያ።
verses.translation: And Azael said, Who is thy servant? a dead dog, that he should do this thing? And Elisaie said, The Lord has shewn me thee ruling over Syria.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ አተወ፡ እምኀበ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ወቦአ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚኡ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ምንተ፡ ይቤለከ፡ ኤልሳዕ፡ ወይቤ፡ ይቤለኒ፡
            ሐዪወአ፡ ተሐዩአ።
verses.translation: And he departed from Elisaie, and went in to his lord; and he said to him, What said Elisaie to thee? and he said, He said to me, Thou shalt surely live.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ በሳኒታ፡ ነሥአ፡ ክዳነ፡ ወጠምዐ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ ወተገልበበ፡ ገጻ፡ ወሞተ፡ ወነግሠ፡ አዛሔል፡ ህየንቴሁ ፤
            አመ፡ ፭ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ወልደ፡ አካአብ፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወኢዮሳፍጥ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the next day that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and put it on his face, and he died: and Azael reigned in his stead.

verses.geez: [ወኢዮራም፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡] ፴ወ፪ዓመቱ፡ ሎቱ፡ አመ፡ ይነግሥ፡ ወ፰ክረምተ፡ ነግሠ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: In the fifth year of Joram son of Achaab king of Israel, and while Josaphat was king of Juda, Joram the son of Josaphat king of Juda began to reign.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ በፍኖቶሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡ እስራኤል፡ በከመ፡ ገብረ፡ ቤተ፡ አካአብ፡ እስመ፡ ወለተ፡ አካአብ፡ ያወስብ፡ ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.geez:
ወኢፈቀደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያማስኖሙ፡ ለይሁዳ፡ እንበይነ፡ ዳዊት፡ ገብሩ፡ በከመ፡ ይቤሎ፡ የሀቦ፡ ማኅቶተ፡ ለወልዱ፡
            በኵሉ፡ መዋዕል።
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achaab; for the daughter of Achaab was his wife: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.

verses.geez: ወበመዋዕሊሁ፡ አፅረሩ፡ ኤዶም፡ ወዐለውዎሙ፡ ለይሁዳ፡ ወአንገሡ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለሊሆሙ፡ ንጉሠ።
verses.translation: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Juda, and they made a king over themselves.

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ውስተ፡ ሲሆር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ሰረገላቲሁ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወተንሥአ፡ ወቀተሎሙ፡ ለኤዶም፡ እለ፡ ዐገትዎ፡
            ወለመላእክተ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ፡ ወእምዝ፡ ጐዩ፡ ወአተዉ፡ አብያቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: And Joram went up to Sior, and all the chariots that were with him: and it came to pass after he had arisen, that he smote Edom who compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

verses.geez: ወአፅረሩ፡ ኤዶም፡ ወዐለውዎሙ፡ ለይሁዳ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡ ወይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ አፅረሩ፡ ሎምና፡ በእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል።
verses.translation: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Juda till this day. Then Lobna revolted at that time.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡ ይሁዳ
።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

verses.geez: ወሰከበ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ምስለ፡ አበዊሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገረ፡ ዳዊት፡ አቡሁ፡ ወነግሠ፡ አካዝያስ፡ ወልዱ፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: So Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David: and Ochozias his son reigned in his stead.

verses.geez: አመ፡ ፲ወ፪ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ወልደ፡ አካአብ፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ነግሠ፡ አካዝያስ፡ ወልደ፡ ኢዮራም።
verses.translation: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Achaab king of Israel, Ochozias son of Joram began to reign.

verses.geez:
እንዘ፡ ፳ወ፪ክራማቲሁ፡ እምዘ፡ ተወልደ፡ አመ፡ ይነግሥ፡ ወ፩ክረምተ፡ ነግሠ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ ወስማ፡ ለእሙ፡ ጎቶልያ፡
            ወለተ፡ ዘንበሪ፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: Twenty and two years old was Ochozias when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem: and the name of his mother was Gotholia, daughter of Ambri king of Israel.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ በፍኖቶሙ፡ ለቤተ፡ አካአብ፡ ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ከመ፡ ቤተ፡ አካአብ።
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab, and did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as did the house of Achaab.

verses.geez:
ወሖረ፡ ምስለ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ወልደ፡ አካአብ፡ ጸብአ፡ ከመ፡ ይቅትልዎ፡ ለአዛሔል፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ኢሎፍሊ፡ በሬማት፡
            ዘገለዓድ፡ ወአቍስልዎ፡ ሶርያ፡ ለኢዮራም።
verses.translation: And he went with Joram the son of Achaab to war against Azael king of the Syrians in Remmoth Galaad; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

verses.geez: ወገብአ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ንጉሥ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይትፈወስ፡ ቍስሎ፡ ዘአቍሰልዎ፡ በሬማት፡ አመ፡ ተቃተለ፡ ምስለ፡ አዛሔል፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ወአካዝየስ፡ ወልደ፡ ኢዮራም፡ ወረደ፡ ይርአዮ፡ ለኢዮራም፡ ወልደ፡ አካአብ፡ ውስተ፡ እስራኤል፡ እስመ፡ ይደዊ።
verses.translation: And king Joram returned to be healed in Jezrael of the wounds with which they wounded him in Remmoth, when he fought with Azael king of Syria. And Ochozias son of Joram went down to see Joram the son of Achaab in Jezrael, because he was sick.
